messages:
dalia: Quick heads up — intermittent NaN spike in FP8 mixed-precision on hosted cluster.

sam: repro steps?

dalia: command: ```
./serve --model redwood-v0.9-fp8 --batch-size 32 --max-seq 4096 --kv-rescale true
``` 
logs: ```
[2026-02-14T12:03:21Z] attn_fp8_v2: matmul overflow -> NaN at layer 18
[2026-02-14T12:03:21Z] output: inf, nan
``` 

yousef: hmm — do we know if batches are concatenated? batching heuristics can merge long-prefixes and blow up effective seq len.

mira: saw similar earlier — when continuous-batcher merges a small real-time request with a queued long-history request we end up with seq ~5k in the kernel, fp8 scaling overflows.

infra-bot: kernel-selector: routed to fp8_attn_v2 for 86% of requests in that window. fallbacks: int8_attn available.

sam: can we try a quick routing policy change to prefer int8 for seq>2048 and see if NaNs disappear? that's low risk.

dalia: I toggled a per-customer override for the failing tenant to route to int8; no NaNs observed in 10m sample. latency +12% on P100 nodes.

yousef: calibration angle: our per-layer scale factors were derived from shorter context calibration (512). With long prefixes the activation distribution shifts and scale * saturation => overflow. SmoothQuant helps but it's calibration-sensitive.

mira: mitigation proposals:
- clamp per-layer scale to a hard max before quantize
- fallback routing policy for extreme seq lengths
- lightweight pre-attention clipping of keys/values
- safe kernel flag that disables fused matmul-epilog optimizations

sam: can we add a runtime counter + alert for "fp8_overflow_count" and auto-release a routing override when it spikes? also collect per-layer scale distribution.

dalia: I'll open an issue with repro and add instrumentation. plan:
1) add fp8_overflow_count metric + per-layer scale histogram
2) rollout routing tweak (int8 for seq>2k) behind a feature flag
3) add clamp to quantization pipe as emergency toggle
4) run calibration sweep with long-prefix traces (use eval harness)

mira: I'll pick up #2 and #3 — will bench perf/regression and post numbers here. @yousef can you help with the calibration sweep config?

yousef: yes — will prepare a long-prefix calibration sample and try smoothquant + per-layer clamp combos. will report speed/quality.

sam: thanks — once we have numbers we can decide defaults for kernel-selector heuristics and rollout to Dedicated clusters.

dalia: thanks all — adding labels: perf, regression, fp8, kv-cache, batching. will update thread with PRs/benchmarks.
